papers.title: Synergistic high negative pressure enables direct lithium crystallization from raw salt-lake brine
papers.abstract_en: Solar-driven separation–crystallization pump achieves direct lithium crystallization from raw salt-lake brine by synergistic evaporation negative pressure and capillary negative pressure.
papers.summary_ko: 태양광 구동 증발-결정화 펌프를 이용해 증발 음압과 모세관 음압을 동시에 활용함으로써 원염호 염수에서 리튬을 직접 결정화하는 공정을 제시했다. 별도의 농축·정제 단계 없이 원염수에서 바로 리튬 결정을 얻을 수 있다는 점이 특징이다. 배터리 전극 재료가 아닌 리튬 원료 추출 공정에 관한 연구다.

papers.title: Oxygen‐Stacking Reconstruction of Spent LiCoO 2 for Fast Li‐Ion Kinetics and High‐Voltage Stability
papers.abstract_en: Recycling spent LiCoO 2 battery cathodes is essential for securing the sustainable supply of lithium and cobalt, yet current recycling methods mainly produce metal salts, precursors, or conventionally regenerated cathodes, making the recovery of high‐value LiCoO 2 with enhanced electrochemical performance remain challenging. To address this challenge, we systematically investigate and compare conventionally regenerated O3‐type LiCoO 2 (O3‐R‐LCO) and O2‐type LiCoO 2 produced through a hydrometallurgy‐assisted ion‐exchange upcycling strategy (O2‐UP‐LCO). The upgraded O2‐UP‐LCO preserves the local CoO 6 framework while exhibiting enlarged Li‐layer spacing and a more open interlayer structure compared with O3‐R‐LCO. Multiscale characterizations further reveal that the distinct oxygen stacking in O2‐UP‐LCO enables fast Li + transport and stable interfacial reaction kinetics, despite reversible phase transitions during cycling. Benefiting from these structural and kinetic advantages, O2‐UP‐LCO delivers 201 mAh g −1 even at 20C in coin cells and achieves an energy density of 486 Wh kg −1 at 1C in a 2 Ah‐level pouch cell. In contrast, O3‐R‐LCO suffers from restricted Li + diffusion and increased interfacial impedance at high voltage, accompanied by aggravated particle cracking after cycling. Overall, this work provides a polymorph‐upgrading strategy for efficient recovery of spent LiCoO 2 material.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 LiCoO2 전극을 수습금속학 기반 이온교환 업사이클링으로 처리해 O2형 LiCoO2(O2-UP-LCO)를 제조하고, 기존 재생법으로 얻은 O3형 LiCoO2(O3-R-LCO)와 구조·전기화학 특성을 비교했다. O2-UP-LCO는 Li층 간격이 넓어진 더 개방적인 층간 구조를 유지해 빠른 Li+ 전달과 안정적인 계면 반응 속도를 보였으며, 코인셀에서 20C에서도 201 mAh g-1을 냈고 1C 2Ah 파우치셀에서 486 Wh kg-1의 에너지 밀도를 달성했다. 반면 O3-R-LCO는 고전압에서 Li+ 확산이 제한되고 계면 임피던스가 커지며 입자 균열이 심화됐다.

papers.title: Octahedral Co 3+ Spin‐State Regulation in W‐Doped Co 3 O 4 for Accelerated Sulfur Redox Kinetics
papers.abstract_en: Lithium–sulfur batteries (LSBs) are promising high‐energy storage systems, but their practical application remains limited by the low electronic conductivity of sulfur, sluggish Li–S redox kinetics, and the lithium polysulfide (LiPS) shuttle effect. These challenges require the rational design of cathode catalysts with well‐regulated electronic structures and active sites. Herein, Cu 2+ and Al 3+ substitution in Co 3 O 4 was first used to identify the catalytic roles of Co sites with different coordination environments, forming CuCo 2 O 4 and CoAl 2 O 4 as model systems. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that octahedral Co 3+ sites play a key role in enhancing LiPS adsorption and Li–S reaction kinetics. Guided by this insight, tungsten species with different oxidation states were used to direct distinct local perturbations of tetrahedral‐ and octahedral‐Co‐site environments in Co 3 O 4, yielding W Td ‐Co 3 O 4 @NC and W Oh ‐Co 3 O 4 @NC, respectively, where NC denotes nitrogen‐doped carbon. Magnetic measurements and DFT calculations demonstrate that W 6+ doping induces a low‐spin to high‐spin transition of Co 3+, generating additional unpaired 3d electrons that strengthen LiPS adsorption and accelerate LiPS conversion. As a result, W Oh ‐Co 3 O 4 @NC/S delivers high capacity, excellent rate capability, and long‐term cycling stability, even under lean‐electrolyte conditions. This work demonstrates spin‐state engineering of octahedral Co 3+ sites as an effective strategy to optimize catalytic activity for LSBs.
papers.summary_ko: Co3O4 내 팔면체 Co3+ 자리가 리튬폴리설파이드(LiPS) 흡착과 Li-S 반응 속도를 좌우함을 Cu2+/Al3+ 치환 모델 시스템과 DFT로 규명하고, W 도핑을 통해 팔면체·사면체 Co 자리를 선택적으로 조절한 WOh-Co3O4@NC와 WTd-Co3O4@NC 촉매를 설계했다. W6+ 도핑이 Co3+의 저스핀→고스핀 전환을 유도해 LiPS 흡착과 전환을 촉진함을 자기 측정과 DFT로 확인했으며, 결과적으로 WOh-Co3O4@NC/S 전극은 린(lean) 전해질 조건에서도 높은 용량과 우수한 율속·장기 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Molecule Bridging Enables Integrated Design of a Hydrogen-Bond Network and Li+ Coordination Chemistry for Long-Life Solid-State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: PEO-based electrolytes extensively applied in solid-state lithium metal batteries are always confronted with issues of sluggish ion transport and unfavorable interfacial stability. Although various supramolecular strategies, particularly H-bond engineering, have been attempted, their actual efficacy is fundamentally crippled by the structural lability of the H-bond cross-linking network (HBCN) and the chemical/electrochemical instability of conventional hydrogen bond donors (HBDs) at the interface. Herein, ellagic acid (EA) with abundant phenolic hydroxyl and lactone groups is identified as a valuable HBD and “molecule bridge” in the PEO-based electrolyte, together with the integrated design of a stable HBCN and favorable Li+ coordination chemistry. Through intense H-bond (C–C–O···H–O) and ion–dipole interactions (Li+···O═C–O), strong PEO–Li+ chelation is effectively weakened while enriching the Li+ solvation sheath with TFSI– and EA. Notably, the appearance of TFSI–-rich Li+ coordination and Li+–EA complex in situ generates a robust LiF-, Li3N-, and PhOLi-rich SEI, facilitating uniform lithium deposition and improved interfacial stability. Consequently, the Li|LFP batteries can achieve a stable Li stripping/plating cycle over 3500 cycles at 1C with a capacity retention of 83.8% at the 1000th. The stable operation of more than 200 cycles at 0.5C of 50 μm Li|LFP pouch batteries further confirms the practicality of the EA molecule bridge.
papers.summary_ko: PEO 기반 고체 전해질에 수소결합 도너(HBD)로 엘라그산(EA)을 도입해 수소결합 가교망(HBCN)과 Li+ 배위화학을 통합 설계했다. EA의 수소결합 및 이온-다이폴 상호작용이 PEO-Li+ 킬레이션을 약화시켜 TFSI-와 EA가 풍부한 Li+ 솔베이션 셸을 형성하고, 이는 LiF/Li3N/PhOLi가 풍부한 안정적 SEI 형성으로 이어져 균일한 리튬 증착을 돕는다. Li|LFP 셀은 1C에서 3500사이클 이상 안정 작동했고(1000사이클 시 용량유지율 83.8%), 50 μm 리튬을 사용한 파우치셀도 0.5C에서 200사이클 이상 안정적으로 작동했다.

papers.title: Interfacial Electronic‐Structural Coupling Suppresses Jahn‐Teller Instability in NASICON Cathode Casting Long Cycling Life
papers.abstract_en: NASICON‐type Na 4 VMn(PO 4) 3 cathodes possess attractive high‐voltage and structural robustness, yet its application is hindered by the intrinsic instability of Mn 3+ ‐induced Jahn‐Teller distortion. A mosaic‐like Na 4 VMn(PO 4) 3 /NaFePO 4 (NVMP/NFP) heterostructure is constructed to achieve interfacial electronic‐structural synergistic regulation. The nanoscale heterointerfaces induce charge redistribution and modify the local electronic environment, thereby strengthening Mn─O interactions indirectly and interrupting the spatial correlation of local distortions, which successfully suppresses the Jahn‐Teller instability. The suppression of local electronic instability by the NVMP/NFP heterostructure is confirmed by complementary experimental and theoretical analyses, which further reveal reversible V 3+ /V 4+ and Mn 2+ /Mn 3+ redox reactions. Furthermore, the heterointerface reconstructs the Na + transport network by generating more interconnected and multidimensional migration pathways with reduced diffusion barriers, mitigates the accumulation of lattice strain during Na + extraction/insertion and fosters electron transfer, casting fast reversible electrochemical reaction. Benefiting from this interfacial electronic‐structural coupling, the optimized NVMP/NFP cathode delivers excellent wide‐temperature cycling stability, retaining 89.91% capacity after 6000 cycles at 2 A g −1, 91.80% after 2500 cycles at ‐15°C, and 80.23% after 6000 cycles at 45°C. This work provides an interfacial engineering strategy for decoupling electronic instability from structural degradation and offers a general pathway for stabilizing Jahn‐Teller active electrode materials.
papers.summary_ko: NASICON형 Na4VMn(PO4)3(NVMP) 양극재는 고전압·구조 안정성이 장점이지만 Mn3+에 의한 얀-텔러 왜곡이 문제였는데, NVMP와 NaFePO4(NFP)를 모자이크형 이종구조로 결합해 계면에서 전자구조적 상호작용을 규제함으로써 이를 억제했다. 이종계면이 전하 재분배를 유도해 Mn-O 결합을 강화하고 국부 왜곡의 공간적 상관성을 끊어 얀-텔러 불안정성을 완화하며, V3+/V4+ 및 Mn2+/Mn3+의 가역적 레독스와 더 다차원적인 Na+ 이동 경로를 제공한다. 최적화된 NVMP/NFP 양극은 2 A g-1에서 6000사이클 후 89.91%, -15°C에서 2500사이클 후 91.80%, 45°C에서 6000사이클 후 80.23%의 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Differentiable Solvation Shell Model for Rational Electrolyte Design
papers.abstract_en: Tailoring the Li+ solvation shell is a central design principle for many emerging Li metal battery electrolytes but remains largely qualitative. Here, we introduce a mean-field Ising model that predicts the Li+ solvation shell from the donor number (DN), acceptor number, molar ratio, and molecular size. The model is end-to-end differentiable, enabling direct parameterization from molecular dynamics (MD) solvation structures. For localized high-concentration electrolytes, it reproduces MD shell compositions with 10.7% RMSE at much reduced cost and captures solvation trends in other electrolyte classes without re-fitting. Model interaction terms show that DN dominates Li+ solvation energetics, explaining the empirical DN-based design rules. For LiTFSI in tetraglyme absent from training, the model identifies fluorobenzene as a diluent and a concentration window with anion-rich solvation shells and low free solvent. The predicted solvation structure is confirmed by MD, and published experiments on related electrolytes support the design principles.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬금속전지 전해질에서 Li+ 솔베이션 셸 설계를 정량화하기 위해 도너수(DN), 억셉터수, 몰비, 분자 크기로부터 솔베이션 구조를 예측하는 평균장 이징 모델을 제시했다. 이 모델은 end-to-end 미분가능해 분자동역학(MD) 솔베이션 구조로부터 직접 파라미터화되며, 고농도 국소화 전해질에서 MD 결과를 10.7% RMSE로 재현하고 재학습 없이도 다른 전해질 계열의 솔베이션 경향을 포착한다. 학습 데이터에 없던 테트라글라임 내 LiTFSI 조성에 대해 플루오로벤젠 희석제와 음이온이 풍부한 솔베이션 셸을 갖는 농도 구간을 제안했고, 이는 MD와 기존 실험 결과로 검증됐다.

papers.title: CD33-CD45 interaction in Alzheimer’s disease susceptibility
papers.abstract_en: CD 33 is associated with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) susceptibility. The AD-associated rs3865444 C risk variant reduces splicing of the sialic acid-binding domain, increasing the sialic acid-binding isoform seven-fold. Here we identify CD45, a GWAS-associated AD risk gene, as an immune cell-specific sialic acid-dependent cis CD33 binding partner, whose phosphatase activity CD33 inhibits. CD33 loss improved microglial amyloid beta clearance and protected against amyloid beta-induced dendritic spine loss in microglial-neuronal co-cultures, whereas CD45 loss impaired clearance, aligning with detrimental effects of CD33-mediated CD45 inhibition. CD33-CD45 interaction frequency was increased in monocytes from rs3865444 CC individuals versus rs3865444 AA , as well as in AD versus controls, independent of genotype. An interaction between CD33 and PTPRC (CD45) expression in human brain tissue was associated with a pathological AD diagnosis and global burden of AD pathology, consistent with the cellular findings above. Together, our results link CD33-mediated suppression of CD45 with AD genetic susceptibility and systemic myeloid dysfunction.
papers.summary_ko: CD33과 면역세포 특이적 결합 파트너인 CD45의 상호작용이 알츠하이머병 감수성 유전 변이(rs3865444)와 연관됨을 밝힌 생의학 연구로, 배터리·전극 소재와는 무관하다.

papers.title: A spectral-spatial interweaver for hyperdimensional photonic computing
papers.abstract_en: Photonic computing offers high bandwidth, parallelism and energy efficiency for artificial intelligence (AI), yet its scalability remains limited by bulky optical components and immature optoelectronic integration. Here we present HyperON, a thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) hyperdimensional optical network built around a passive spectral-spatial interweaver and broadband wavelength-parallel modulators. The interweaver combines wavelength multiplexing with spatial replication in a log 2 P -stage network, delivering the full wavelength set to every spatial output without beam-combination loss. By interweaving P spectral channels with K spatial units, HyperON forms a unified P × K parallel computing framework, supporting O ( N 2 ) operations with only O ( N ) modulators, improving hardware efficiency and scalability. A 16 × 16 interweaver shows low-loss, broadband and highly uniform operation across 1523.40-1568.85 nm, with 1.30 dB average loss, 0.196 dB output-port variation and 0.414 dB cross-wavelength variation. The integrated wavelength-parallel modulators retain system-level bandwidths of 53-67 GHz after large-scale routing, while standalone devices exhibit bandwidths beyond 67 GHz. Together, these features enable the fabricated HyperON chip to deliver a projected peak throughput of 32.8 TMAC/s, with estimated energy and area efficiencies of 7.04 TMAC/s/W and 0.163 TMAC/s/mm 2 , respectively. Experimental demonstrations in image convolution, handwritten digit recognition, and 64-mode parallel computing confirm its high speed operation, versatility, and scalability for large-scale AI workloads.
papers.summary_ko: 박막 리튬나이오베이트(TFLN) 기반 초차원 광컴퓨팅 칩(HyperON)에 관한 연구로, 파장-공간 다중화를 이용한 광학 연산 아키텍처를 다룬다. 배터리 전극 소재와는 무관한 포토닉 컴퓨팅 분야 논문이다.

papers.title: Ultrasonic Fabrication of Protected Lithium Metal Particles for High‐Performance Thin Anodes
papers.abstract_en: Micron‐scale adhesive lithium metal particles (ALMPs) are fabricated via a cost‐effective and scalable ultrasonication method at 30°C to break down bulky lithium metal. By manipulating the sonication time and formulations of the sonication solution, the chemical composition of the protective shells on ALMPs can be engineered. ALMPs produced in an ethylene carbonate/dimethoxyethane mixed solvent containing LiTFSI form an organic–inorganic balanced shell that contains LiF, Li 3 N, Li 2 SO 3, and Li 2 SO 4. The resulting ALMPs exhibit intrinsic adhesiveness, enabling the fabrication of thin lithium (Li ALMP) electrodes by rolling without the use of binders. The thickness (5–45 µm) and areal capacity of the Li ALMP electrode are tunable by adjusting the ALMP loading amount. The Li ALMP electrode is stable under dry air and exhibits excellent mechanical robustness in bending, coiling, and adhesion tests. Owing to its higher effective surface area and the presence of a unique artificial solid‐electrolyte interphase, the Li ALMP electrode shows reduced polarization, more uniform Li plating/stripping behavior, and enhanced tolerance to high operation current densities compared with a conventional lithium‐foil (Li Conv) electrode. A LiNi 0.6 Mn 0.2 Co 0.2 O 2 //Li ALMP cell demonstrates superior rate capability and cycling stability relative to a LiNi 0.6 Mn 0.2 Co 0.2 O 2 //Li Conv cell. The thin Li ALMP electrode is highly promising for high‐energy‐density battery applications.
papers.summary_ko: 저가·확장 가능한 초음파 처리로 벌크 리튬 금속을 분쇄해 미크론 크기의 접착성 리튬금속입자(ALMP)를 제조하고, 초음파 용액 조성(EC/DME + LiTFSI)을 조절해 LiF, Li3N, Li2SO3, Li2SO4로 구성된 유무기 혼합 보호층을 입자 표면에 형성했다. 이 ALMP는 자체 접착성을 가져 바인더 없이 압연만으로 5-45 μm 두께의 박형 리튬 전극 제작이 가능하며, 건조 공기에서도 안정하고 굽힘·권취에도 우수한 기계적 강건성을 보인다. 넓은 유효 표면적과 독특한 인공 SEI로 인해 기존 리튬 호일 전극보다 분극이 낮고 균일한 플레이팅/스트리핑 거동을 보여, LiNi0.6Mn0.2Co0.2O2 전지에서 더 우수한 율속·사이클 특성을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Steric Asymmetry‐Induced Hyperconjugation Enables Stable Anode‐Free Sodium Pouch Cells
papers.abstract_en: Anode‐free sodium batteries (AFSBs) hold great promise for high‐energy storage; however, their practical application is hindered by poor cycling stability arising from inefficient sodium‐metal electroplating–stripping. Guided by hyperconjugation theory, 1‐ethoxy‐2‐methoxyethane (EEME) is identified as the optimal solvent, as its sterically asymmetric ethyl terminus provides a hyperconjugation‐enabled polarization pathway while maintaining moderate Na + ‐coordination strength. This steric‐induced hyperconjugation amplifies the positive electrostatic potential in EEME, creating a persistent anion‐affinitive site that retains PF 6 − near Na + solvation structures and promotes their correlated transport toward the negatively polarized electrode. The resulting NaF‐rich interphase enables highly reversible and dendrite‐free Na electroplating/stripping. Benefiting from these, at pouch‐cell level, the EEME‐based electrolyte enabled durable anode‐free Al/C||Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4) 2 P 2 O 7 cells, retaining remarkable 85.9% after 1600 cycles at 0.5C with superior rate capability up to 5C. Notably, the EEME‐based electrolyte also enabled excellent low‐temperature performance, with the pouch cell preserving 98.6% of its room‐temperature capacity at −20 °C and retaining 93.5% capacity after 150 cycles. This work establishes the stereoelectronic‐solvation design principle that connects fundamental conformational chemistry with rational electrolyte engineering for practical AFSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극 소듐전지(AFSB)의 불균일한 Na 금속 전기도금/스트리핑 문제를 해결하기 위해 하이퍼컨주게이션 이론에 기반해 1-에톡시-2-메톡시에탄(EEME)을 최적 용매로 선정했다. EEME의 비대칭 에틸 말단이 적절한 Na+ 배위 강도를 유지하면서도 하이퍼컨주게이션 기반 분극 경로를 제공해 PF6- 음이온을 Na+ 솔베이션 구조 근처에 유지시켜 음이온이 풍부한 NaF 계면을 형성, 가역적이고 덴드라이트 없는 Na 플레이팅/스트리핑을 가능케 한다. 이를 적용한 무음극 Al/C||Na4Fe3(PO4)2P2O7 파우치셀은 0.5C에서 1600사이클 후 85.9%의 용량을 유지했고 -20°C에서도 상온 용량의 98.6%를 보였다.

papers.title: Reaction‐Pathway Regulation for Degradation‐Insensitive Direct Regeneration of Spent LiNi 0.5 Co 0.2 Mn 0.3 O 2 Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: (NCM523) cathode materials with different degradation states, we show that this limitation originates from competition among relithiation, structural recovery, and thermal decomposition during calcination. As the balance of these competing reactions shifts with degradation state, cathodes evolve along distinct reaction trajectories. Recognizing that these reactions are governed by the reactants, we regulate the regeneration reaction through the lithium-source reactant, causing cathode materials with different degradation states to pass through the same type of low-symmetry, synthesis-derived intermediate structure during calcination. This redirects regeneration toward a reconstruction pathway with favorable thermodynamics and improved ion diffusion, enabling rapid Li replenishment, long-range cation ordering, and structural restoration. Consequently, practical NCM523 black mass is regenerated into cathodes that deliver higher capacity and better capacity retention than those regenerated via the conventional pathway, and a 1.3 Ah pouch cell with the regenerated cathode retains 80.2% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles. This reconstruction pathway also enables direct upcycling of degraded NCM523 toward higher-Ni compositions. Broadly, this work provides a mechanistic framework for reducing degradation-state dependence in direct regeneration of spent cathode materials.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2(NCM523) 양극재의 직접 재생에서 열처리 중 재리튬화, 구조 복원, 열분해 경쟁이 성능 저하의 원인임을 규명하고, 리튬원 반응물을 조절해 서로 다른 퇴화 상태의 양극재가 동일한 저대칭 합성유래 중간구조를 거치도록 유도했다. 이를 통해 재생 경로를 재구성 방향으로 유도해 빠른 리튬 보충, 장거리 양이온 정렬, 구조 복원을 달성했으며, 재생된 NCM523은 1.3 Ah 파우치셀에서 1000사이클 후 80.2%의 용량유지율을 보였다. 이 접근은 퇴화 상태에 둔감한 재생 메커니즘을 제공하며 고니켈 조성으로의 직접 업사이클링도 가능케 한다.

papers.title: Hierarchical Order‐Disorder Architecture Enables Reversible Mg–N Coordination in Prussian Blue Analogues for Aqueous Mg Ion Storage
papers.abstract_en: Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) are promising cathodes for aqueous magnesium ion batteries (AMIBs), yet their Mg 2+ storage chemistry is commonly limited by weak interaction between divalent Mg 2+ and the rigid cyanide‐bridged framework. Herein, we present a hierarchical order‐disorder engineering strategy to reshape the local coordination chemistry of FeCo‐PBA through Sn/Mn regulation. The resulting FeCoSnMn‐PBA integrates a long‐range ordered Fe─C≡N─M framework with short‐range disordered coordination domains, simultaneously preserving framework stability and electronically activating framework N sites. In situ Raman spectroscopy, charge density difference analysis, in situ XRD, and electronic structure calculations reveal that the activated N sites enable a reversible Mg─N coordination‐mediated storage mechanism, moving beyond conventional interstitial Mg 2+ accommodation in PBA cathodes. This coordination‐regulated chemistry promotes homogeneous Mg 2+ storage, rapid charge and mass transfer, and highly reversible lattice evolution. Consequently, the FeCoSnMn‐PBA//activated carbon (AC) hybrid device delivers 149.4 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 and retains 72.9 mAh g −1 after 5000 cycles at 1.0 A g −1. A FeCoSnMn‐PBA//perylene‐3,4,9,10‐tetracarboxylic dianhydride (PTCDA) full cell further demonstrates stable Mg 2+ storage. This work establishes local structure regulation as a powerful route to modulate coordination‐mediated multivalent ion storage in PBA frameworks.
papers.summary_ko: FeCo 프러시안블루 유사체(PBA)에 Sn/Mn을 도입해 장거리 질서와 단거리 무질서가 공존하는 계층적 구조를 형성함으로써 수계 마그네슘이온전지용 양극의 Mg-N 배위 기반 저장 메커니즘을 구현한 연구로, 리튬·소듐 계열이 아닌 Mg 이온전지 전극에 관한 것이다.

papers.title: Halide Anions Regulate the Self‐Assembly of HPMC Coating on PP Separator to Synergistically Modulate Weak Solvation Structure and Anode Interface to Enhance Lithium Metal Battery
papers.abstract_en: Modifying the separator is the most straightforward strategy to stabilizing lithium metal batteries (LMBs). This work presents a functional coating separator fabricated through halide anion (Cl −, Br −, and I −)‐regulated self‐assembly of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC) on PP separator, achieving the dual modulation of Li + solvation structure and anode interfacial chemistry. Cl − induces a chiral nematic liquid crystal (CLC) structure with an optimal helical pitch, enabling ordered Li + transport and uniform deposition. Br − gives an intermediate pitch with slightly inferior performance, while I − causes an overly large pitch that disrupts transport channels and contribute to inhomogeneous lithium deposition. Halide anions can be incorporated into the Li + solvation sheath, weakening Li + ‐solvent interactions to form an anion‐dominated structure that lowers the desolvation barrier. Moreover, a hybrid solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) layer enriched in LiF with LiCl, LiBr, and LiI forms on the anode, respectively, offering high mechanical robustness and ionic conductivity to suppress dendrites. Consequently, the H‐Cl@PP‐based Li||LiFePO 4 cell delivers 103.8% capacity retention after 400 cycles at 1 C, while the high‐voltage Li||NCM811 cells incorporating H‐Cl@PP and H‐Br@PP retain 66.1% and 66.5% after 300 cycles at 0.5 C. This work provides new insights into separator engineering for synergistic regulation of Li + coordination environment and interfacial chemistry.
papers.summary_ko: PP 분리막에 할라이드 음이온(Cl-, Br-, I-)으로 조절한 하이드록시프로필 메틸셀룰로오스(HPMC) 자기조립 코팅을 적용해 Li+ 솔베이션 구조와 음극 계면화학을 동시에 조절했다. Cl-은 최적의 나선 피치를 가진 키랄 네마틱 액정 구조를 유도해 질서있는 Li+ 전달과 균일한 증착을 이끌며, 할라이드 음이온이 솔베이션 셸에 편입되어 탈솔베이션 장벽을 낮추고 LiF/LiCl/LiBr/LiI가 풍부한 혼합 SEI를 형성해 덴드라이트를 억제한다. H-Cl@PP 적용 Li||LiFePO4 셀은 1C 400사이클 후 103.8%의 용량유지율을, 고전압 Li||NCM811 셀은 0.5C 300사이클 후 각각 66.1%, 66.5%의 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Gating Oxygen Flux in High‐Nickel Layered Cathodes via a Surface‐Bulk Oxygen‐Fixation Framework
papers.abstract_en: High‐Ni layered oxide cathodes suffer from severe high‐voltage degradation driven by oxygen‐vacancy evolution, lattice oxygen release, and interfacial reconstruction. Here, a LaCeNb 6 O 18 ‐modified LiNi 0.867 Co 0.103 Mn 0.003 O 2 cathode is designed to establish an oxygen‐fixation‐gate (OFG) framework for regulating oxygen flux across the surface‐bulk region. The modified cathode establishes a spatial oxygen‐fixation‐gate framework, integrating bulk oxygen locking by Nb, surface oxygen retention by La/Ce, and interfacial oxygen buffering by the oxygen‐vacancy‐rich layer. STEM, depth‐resolved XPS, XAS, DEMS, EPR, in situ XRD, and DFT calculations reveal that this coupled regulation stabilizes both oxygen chemistry and structural evolution. Specifically, the oxygen‐vacancy formation energy at the fully delithiated state increases from 1.13 to 1.31 eV, O 2 evolution during initial high‐voltage charging is nearly eliminated, and oxygen‐defect accumulation during cycling is markedly restrained. Consequently, the optimized 867‐LCNO0.5 cathode delivers 158.15 mAh g −1 at 10 C, retains 87.23% capacity after 200 cycles, and maintains 80.03% retention after 200 cycles at 4.5 V vs. Li/Li +. This work establishes a spatially programmed oxygen‐fixation framework integrating bulk lattice oxygen locking, surface/subsurface oxygen anchoring, and interfacial oxygen‐vacancy buffering.
papers.summary_ko: 고니켈 층상양극(LiNi0.867Co0.103Mn0.003O2)의 고전압 퇴화를 막기 위해 LaCeNb6O18로 표면을 개질해 Nb에 의한 벌크 산소 고정, La/Ce에 의한 표면 산소 유지, 산소공공층에 의한 계면 산소 버퍼링이 결합된 산소고정게이트(OFG) 구조를 설계했다. 이 구조는 완전 탈리튬 상태의 산소공공 형성에너지를 1.13→1.31 eV로 높여 고전압 충전 중 O2 발생을 거의 없애고 산소결함 축적을 억제한다. 최적화된 양극은 10C에서 158.15 mAh g-1을 내고 200사이클 후 87.23%, 4.5V 조건 200사이클 후 80.03%의 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Function‐Decoupled Dual‐Anion Doping via Site‐Preferential Regulation Enables High‐Performance Lithium Argyrodite Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: All‐solid‐state lithium metal batteries adopting argyrodite‐type sulfide solid‐state electrolytes (SSEs) offer enhanced safety and energy density, yet face challenges in balancing ionic conductivity, air stability and interfacial compatibility. Herein, we pioneer a precursor‐directed site‐preferential dual‐anion doping strategy to address these trade‐offs. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal the oxygen precursor dictates the predominant anion occupancy: Li 2 O kinetically favors O at the 4d sites, whereas P 2 O 5 preferentially directs O to the 16e sites. Guided by this principle, Li 6 PS 4.2 O 0.4 Se 0.4 Cl (LPSOSeCl) SSEs is designed, wherein O preferentially enriches 16e sites to enhance air stability and widen the electrochemical window for high‐voltage cathode compatibility, whereas Se preferentially enriches 4d sites to compensate ionic conductivity and promote a Li 2 Se/Li 2 O‐rich interphase for dendrite suppression. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations combined with radial distribution functions (RDFs) further reveal that the Se/O co‐doping facilitates the formation of a stable Li/SSE interface, significantly inhibiting LPSOSeCl SSE reduction. The resulting LPSOSeCl SSE achieves high ionic conductivity, excellent moist air stability and remarkable critical current density (CCD) of 2.6 mA cm −2. The Li||Li symmetric cells demonstrate ultralong cycling stability over 4000 h at 0.2 mA cm −2 and LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 full cells rentain 70.7% capacity retention after 500 cycles at 0.3C.
papers.summary_ko: 아지로다이트형 황화물 고체전해질의 이온전도도-대기안정성-계면 호환성 트레이드오프를 해결하기 위해 전구체(Li2O vs P2O5)가 O의 4d/16e 자리 선점을 좌우한다는 DFT 결과를 바탕으로, O는 16e 자리에 Se는 4d 자리에 선택적으로 도핑된 Li6PS4.2O0.4Se0.4Cl(LPSOSeCl)을 설계했다. O 도핑은 대기안정성과 고전압 양극 호환성을 높이고 Se 도핑은 이온전도도를 보완하며 Li2Se/Li2O가 풍부한 계면을 형성해 덴드라이트를 억제, AIMD 시뮬레이션으로 Se/O 공도핑이 Li/SSE 계면에서 전해질 환원을 억제함을 확인했다. 이 SSE는 높은 임계전류밀도(2.6 mA cm-2)와 Li 대칭셀 4000시간 이상의 초장기 안정성을 보였고, LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 전지에서도 우수한 용량유지율을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Foreign‐Element‐Free Lattice Reorganization Constructs Multi‐Scale Heterostructure for Stable Oxygen Redox in Li‐Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Lithium‐rich manganese‐based layered oxide (LRMO) suffers from rapid capacity fading caused by structural degradation induced by irreversible lattice oxygen release, which severely hinders its commercialization. Here, we propose a citric acid‐assisted solution infiltration and in situ lattice reconstruction strategy to simultaneously construct a uniform rock‐salt/layered intergrowth layer on the surface and discrete nano‐rock‐salt domains in the bulk of Li 1.2 Mn 0.54 Ni 0.13 Co 0.13 O 2. Theoretical calculations and experimental characterizations collectively reveal that this multi‐scale heterostructure thermodynamically suppresses irreversible oxygen release by raising the oxygen vacancy formation energy from 1.36 to 2.19 eV, via strong hybridization between low‐valence Ni 2+ and oxygen ions. Meanwhile, the bulk nano‐rock‐salt domains serve as structural anchors, buffering anisotropic lattice strain through a mechanical anchoring effect and inhibiting the nucleation and propagation of microcracks. Furthermore, in situ XRD and EIS analyses demonstrate that this structure effectively alleviates lattice distortion during cycling, enhances interfacial stability, and improves Li + diffusion kinetics. Consequently, the modified cathode exhibits significantly enhanced electrochemical performance, achieving a capacity retention of 82.3% after 300 cycles at 1 C and delivering an excellent discharge capacity of 145.2 mAh·g −1 at 10 C. This study provides a feasible design strategy and theoretical basis for developing high‐stability, long‐life LRMO through heterostructure engineering.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬리치 망간계 층상산화물(Li1.2Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2)의 비가역적 격자산소 방출에 의한 용량저하를 막기 위해 구연산 보조 용액침투와 인시튜 격자재구성을 통해 표면에 균일한 암염/층상 혼성층을, 벌크에는 분산된 나노암염 영역을 동시에 형성했다. 이 다중스케일 이종구조는 저가 Ni2+와 산소의 강한 혼성화를 통해 산소공공 형성에너지를 1.36→2.19 eV로 높여 비가역적 산소 방출을 열역학적으로 억제하며, 벌크의 나노암염 영역은 이방성 격자 변형을 완충해 미세균열 발생·전파를 억제한다. 개질된 양극은 1C 300사이클 후 82.3%의 용량유지율과 10C에서 145.2 mAh g-1의 방전용량을 보였다.

papers.title: Engineering Porous Nano‐SiO 2 From Clay Minerals via a Machine Learning Framework for High‐Performance Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Porous nano‐SiO 2 with well‐developed pore structures and unique surface chemistry is highly desirable across multiple fields, yet its synthesis from clay minerals involves intricate multi‐parameter interactions that challenge conventional optimization. Herein, we developed a machine learning (ML)‐based framework that integrates predictive modeling, interpretability analysis, and domain adaptation to accelerate the synthesis of high‐specific‐surface‐area (SSA) porous nano‐SiO 2. Using montmorillonite (Mnt) as the precursor, the optimized Random Forest model guided the synthesis of amorphous, silanol‐rich porous nano‐SiO 2 with an exceptional SSA of 747.1 m 2 g −1, surpassing most previously reported clay‐derived nano‐SiO 2. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) identified key process descriptors, while experimental investigations revealed that the high SSA originates from a balance between pore formation and framework collapse. Through residual learning with only 20 additional samples, the framework was effectively adapted to black talc (BTlc) and palygorskite (Pal). Additionally, the optimized clay‐derived nano‐SiO 2 was employed as a porous buffer layer on the Na anode and a separator modifier, exhibiting improved interfacial stability and Na + regulation capabilities, demonstrating its potential for energy storage applications. This work establishes a data‐driven pathway for ML‐accelerated clay mineral valorization toward functional nanomaterial synthesis.
papers.summary_ko: 점토광물(몬모릴로나이트)로부터 다공성 나노SiO2를 합성하는 복잡한 다변수 공정을 가속화하기 위해 예측모델링·해석·도메인적응을 결합한 머신러닝 프레임워크를 개발했다. 최적화된 랜덤포레스트 모델로 유도한 비정질·실라놀이 풍부한 나노SiO2는 비표면적 747.1 m2 g-1을 달성해 기존 점토유래 나노SiO2를 상회했으며, SHAP 분석으로 핵심 공정 변수를 규명하고 단 20개의 추가 샘플로 블랙탈크·팔리고스카이트 등 다른 점토로 전이학습이 가능함을 보였다. 이 나노SiO2를 소듐 금속 음극의 다공성 버퍼층 및 분리막 개질제로 적용해 계면 안정성과 Na+ 조절 능력이 향상됨을 확인했다.

papers.title: Dilute Configurational Frustration Enables Reversible Jahn–Teller Strain Accommodation in ZnMn 2 O 4 Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Jahn–Teller distortion is a major origin of instability in Mn 3+ ‐containing cathodes, yet most stabilization strategies aim to suppress local MnO 6 distortion. Structural degradation, however, also depends critically on whether the associated lattice strain is reversibly relaxed or accumulates as residual deformation during cycling. Here, we introduce dilute configurational frustration to regulate Jahn–Teller‐associated strain in spinel ZnMn 2 O 4 cathodes for aqueous zinc‐ion batteries. Dilute Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, and Al substitution creates chemically inequivalent local coordination environments while preserving the Mn‐rich spinel framework. This local chemical heterogeneity disrupts the spatial correlation of Jahn–Teller responses to curb persistent strain accumulation, while an elevated Mn valence concurrently reinforces local coordination by mitigating intrinsic distortion susceptibility. As a result, the multication‐regulated cathode exhibits enhanced structural recovery, reduced residual deformation, and better‐preserved Mn─O coordination. Consequently, it retains 112.8 mAh g −1 after 3000 cycles at 2 A g −1 with over 80% capacity retention. These results establish reversible strain accommodation, rather than complete suppression of lattice distortion, as an effective route for stabilizing Jahn–Teller‐active cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 스피넬 ZnMn2O4 수계 아연이온전지 양극에서 Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Al을 희박 치환해 국소 배위환경을 화학적으로 불균일하게 만들어 얀-텔러 변형이 비가역적으로 축적되는 것을 억제한 연구로, 리튬·소듐 계열이 아닌 아연이온전지 전극에 관한 것이다.

papers.title: An Adsorption‐Driven Solvophobic Interface for Stable Lithium‐Rich Manganese‐Based Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Lithium‐rich manganese‐based (LRMO) oxides represent the premier cathode candidates for next‐generation high‐energy‐density batteries due to high specific capacity exceeding 300 mAh g −1. However, the practical deployment of LRMO cathodes under high voltages (>4.8 V) is severely hindered by severe electrolyte oxidation and transition‐metal (TM) dissolution. Herein, perfluorobutanesulfonyl fluoride (NfF) is introduced as a multifunctional additive to construct a robust solvophobic interphase on LRMO cathodes. The ‐SO 2 F group preferentially anchors to exposed TM sites, suppressing metal dissolution, while the perfluorinated chain excludes free solvent molecules from the cathode surface and mitigates oxidative electrolyte decomposition. The resulting inorganic‐rich (LiF/Li x SO y) engineered interface mitigates the irreversible layered‐to‐spinel phase transition and inhibits TM crosstalk to the lithium metal anode, ensuring exceptional structural integrity and rapid ionic transport kinetics. Consequently, Li||LRMO coin cells sustain over 1000 cycles at 3 C. The Li||LRMO full cells based on a 40 µm lithium anode and cathode loading of 8 mg cm −2 retain 173 mAh g −1 after 110 cycles. Moreover, the 1.2 Ah Li||LRMO pouch cells achieve 88% capacity retention after 50 cycles at 4.8 V. This work demonstrates solvophobic interphase engineering as an effective strategy for stabilizing high‐voltage cathodes through coordinated regulation of interfacial chemistry and electrolyte accessibility.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬리치 망간계(LRMO) 양극의 고전압(>4.8V) 구동 시 전해질 산화와 전이금속 용출을 막기 위해 과불화부탄설포닐플루오라이드(NfF) 첨가제로 솔보포빅 계면을 형성했다. -SO2F 기가 노출된 전이금속 자리에 우선 결합해 금속 용출을 억제하고 과불화 사슬이 자유 용매분자를 양극 표면에서 배제해 산화 분해를 줄이며, 생성된 LiF/LixSOy 중심의 무기질 계면이 층상-스피넬 상전이를 억제하고 리튬금속 음극으로의 전이금속 크로스토크도 차단한다. Li||LRMO 코인셀은 3C에서 1000사이클 이상 지속됐고 40 μm 리튬 음극을 적용한 전지는 110사이클 후 173 mAh g-1을, 1.2 Ah 파우치셀은 4.8V·50사이클에서 88%의 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: 4 V‐Class Calcium‐Based Water‐in‐Salt Electrolyte for Aqueous Calcium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: We report the first systematic investigation and demonstration of calcium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (Ca(TFSI) 2) as a water‐in‐salt electrolyte for aqueous calcium‐ion batteries (CIBs). At its solubility limit (6.2 m), Ca(TFSI) 2 exhibits a surprisingly wide electrochemical stability window (ESW) of 4.19 V, notably with the cathodic limit extending to ‐2.52 V vs Ag/AgCl, significantly surpassing previously reported Ca‐based aqueous electrolytes. Spectroscopic characterization combined with molecular simulations reveals a distinctive solvation structure in which Ca 2+ coordinates oxygen atoms from both H 2 O and TFSI − within the first coordination shell, with an average coordination number of 7. Extensive ion association is also evident through solvent‐shared ion pairs, consistent with suppressed water activity and an expanded ESW. Furthermore, the addition of a small amount of acetonitrile enables the electrolyte to remain liquid at sub‐zero temperatures, while lowering viscosity and enhancing ionic conductivity without substantially disrupting the Ca 2+ solvation structure. Leveraging these electrolyte properties, full cells employing perylene‐3,4,9,10‐tetracarboxylic diimide or Sn anodes and a Prussian blue analogue cathode demonstrate robust electrochemical performance at −20°C, including operation over a 3.2 V window with the Sn‐based cell, with long‐term cycling stability and sub‐zero device operation. These findings establish Ca(TFSI) 2 ‐based water‐in‐salt electrolytes as a versatile platform for wide‐voltage, low‐temperature aqueous CIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 칼슘이온전지용 water-in-salt 전해질로 Ca(TFSI)2를 체계적으로 검증해 용해한계(6.2 m)에서 4.19V의 넓은 전기화학안정성 창을 구현한 연구로, 리튬·소듐 계열이 아닌 칼슘이온전지 전해질에 관한 것이다.

papers.title: Poly(ethyl cyanoacrylate) binder prepared via anionic polymerization for improved structural integrity and electrochemical performance of LiFePO4 cathodes
papers.summary_ko: 음이온 중합으로 제조한 폴리(에틸 시아노아크릴레이트) 바인더를 이용해 LiFePO4 양극의 구조적 안정성과 전기화학 성능을 개선한 연구로 추정된다. (제목 기반 추정)
